name: Connecting to AWS: Client VPN, Site-to-Site VPN, PrivateLink and Direct Connect

lesson.summary: There are several ways to connect people and networks to AWS. AWS Client VPN gives remote workers secure access. AWS Site-to-Site VPN links a data center or office to a VPC over an encrypted connection. AWS PrivateLink connects a VPC privately to services without using the internet. AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private connection with more consistent performance and bandwidth.
keyPoints: AWS Client VPN gives remote workers secure access to AWS resources and on-premises networks
AWS Site-to-Site VPN creates an encrypted connection between a data center or branch office and a VPC
AWS PrivateLink connects a VPC privately to services without an internet gateway, NAT device or public IP address
AWS Direct Connect is a dedicated private network connection between your network and AWS, with more consistent bandwidth
Use Site-to-Site VPN for a low-cost secure link that does not need more bandwidth; use Direct Connect for large or steady data transfers

scenarios.text: A company with several branch offices wants encrypted connections between those offices and AWS. It does not need more bandwidth than a standard internet connection gives, and it wants the lowest cost option.

questions.explanation: Site-to-Site VPN gives encrypted connections between office networks and a VPC at a lower cost, without a dedicated line. Direct Connect is for higher or more consistent bandwidth, Client VPN is for individual remote users, and PrivateLink connects a VPC to services.

questions.prompt: Which option gives remote workers secure access to AWS resources from anywhere?
questions.explanation: AWS Client VPN is a managed VPN service that gives remote workers secure access. Direct Connect is a dedicated line for sites, an internet gateway serves public traffic, and CloudFront delivers content.

questions.prompt: A company must move a large data warehouse to AWS and keep a part of its on-premises systems. It needs high, consistent bandwidth for the transfers. Which option fits best?
questions.explanation: Direct Connect is a dedicated private connection with more consistent bandwidth, which suits large migrations and hybrid setups. Client VPN is for remote users, a standard internet connection is shared and can be congested, and PrivateLink connects a VPC to services rather than a data center.

questions.statement: AWS PrivateLink requires an internet gateway, a NAT device or a public IP address to reach AWS services.
questions.explanation: False. PrivateLink connects a VPC to services privately without an internet gateway, NAT device, public IP address, Direct Connect, or VPN.

questions.prompt: Type the name of the AWS service that gives a dedicated private network connection between your network and AWS.
questions.explanation: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection between your network and AWS.
